analogy.rationale: Non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors target HIV reverse transcriptase, which is not expressed in these human cell lines, so they should produce little to no transcriptional response; the annotated CYP targets reflect off-target metabolism rather than a transcriptional program. Other HIV antivirals and CYP inhibitors are the closest classes but also lack a shared expressed target program.
